title: Missed information drill: A leak from the unit above
context: You will hear a tenant talking to her neighbour late one evening after she finds water coming through her bathroom ceiling.

segments.speaker: Rosa
segments.text: Tomás, sorry to bang on your door so late. Do you know anything about the unit above me? There's water dripping through my bathroom ceiling, right by the light fixture.

segments.speaker: Tomás
segments.text: Oh no. That's four-oh-two. Did you knock?

segments.speaker: Tomás
segments.text: Yeah, the owner's in Mexico till the end of the month, I think. Okay, first thing, don't touch that light. Turn off the breaker for the bathroom. Water and electricity, you know.

segments.speaker: Rosa
segments.text: Right, good thinking. Then what, call the landlord?

segments.speaker: Tomás
segments.text: Call the building's emergency line first. It's not the regular office number, it's the after-hours one on the yellow sticker by the elevator.

segments.speaker: Tomás
segments.text: When it happened to me last year, the caretaker came up with a master key in, like, twenty minutes.

segments.speaker: Rosa
segments.text: Okay. Twenty minutes I can handle. I'll put some towels and a bucket down.

segments.speaker: Tomás
segments.text: And take photos before you clean anything up. The ceiling, the floor, anything that's damaged. Your tenant insurance will want them.

segments.speaker: Rosa
segments.text: I'm not even sure my policy covers this. I've only had it since March.

segments.speaker: Tomás
segments.text: Most do, but call them tomorrow to check. Oh, and email your landlord tonight, even if you've already called the emergency line. You want it in writing, with the time.

segments.speaker: Rosa
segments.text: Got it. Breaker, emergency line, photos, email. Thanks, Tomás. Seriously.

questions.prompt: Why can't Rosa get help from the people in unit 402?

options.text: The owner refused to open the door.
options.whyVi: Không ai từ chối; đơn giản là không có ai ở nhà.

options.text: Tomás doesn't know who lives there.
options.whyVi: Tomás biết rõ chủ căn hộ đang đi Mexico.

options.text: The owner is away on a trip.
options.whyVi: Đúng: chủ căn hộ ở Mexico đến cuối tháng.

options.text: The unit is empty because it's being renovated.
options.whyVi: Bài không nói căn hộ đang sửa chữa.

questions.evidence: the owner's in Mexico till the end of the month
questions.explanationVi: Tomás nói nhanh 'the owner's in Mexico till the end of the month' – thông tin dễ lỡ vì đi kèm 'I think'. 'In Mexico' = 'away on a trip'.

questions.prompt: Where will Rosa find the number she should call first?

options.text: On a sticker near the elevator.
options.whyVi: Đúng: số khẩn cấp ngoài giờ nằm trên nhãn dán màu vàng cạnh thang máy.

options.text: On the regular building office website.
options.whyVi: Tomás nói rõ KHÔNG phải số văn phòng thường ('not the regular office number').
Bảo hiểm được nhắc sau, không liên quan đến số khẩn cấp.

options.text: In an email from her landlord.
options.whyVi: Email được nhắc nhưng là việc Rosa sẽ gửi cho chủ nhà.

questions.evidence: it's the after-hours one on the yellow sticker by the elevator
questions.explanationVi: Câu 'It's not the regular office number' là bẫy; thông tin đúng nằm ngay sau: 'on the yellow sticker by the elevator'.

questions.prompt: According to Tomás, what should Rosa do before cleaning up the water?

options.whyVi: Tomás bảo gọi bảo hiểm vào ngày mai, không phải trước khi lau dọn.

options.text: Wait for the caretaker to inspect the damage.
options.whyVi: Tomás không nói phải chờ người quản lý kiểm tra.

options.text: Send photos to the owner of unit 402.
options.whyVi: Ảnh dùng cho bảo hiểm của Rosa; không nói gửi cho chủ căn 402.

options.text: Take pictures of everything that's damaged.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'take photos before you clean anything up'.

questions.evidence: And take photos before you clean anything up.
questions.explanationVi: Từ khóa 'before you clean anything up' khớp với câu hỏi. 'Take photos' = 'take pictures'.

questions.prompt: Why does Tomás tell Rosa to email her landlord tonight?

options.text: The emergency line might not answer at night.
options.whyVi: Tomás không nói đường dây khẩn cấp có thể không trả lời.

options.text: So there is a written record showing when she reported it.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'You want it in writing, with the time'.

options.text: Because her landlord is in Mexico.
options.whyVi: Người ở Mexico là chủ căn 402, không phải chủ nhà của Rosa.

options.text: To ask the landlord to pay her insurance claim.
options.whyVi: Bài không nói chủ nhà trả tiền bảo hiểm.

questions.evidence: You want it in writing, with the time.
questions.explanationVi: 'In writing, with the time' = có bằng chứng bằng văn bản ghi thời gian báo sự cố. Đáp án B diễn đạt lại thành 'a written record showing when she reported it'.

vocabulary.definition: a light that is attached to a ceiling or wall
vocabulary.example: Water is dripping right by the light fixture.

vocabulary.definition: a switch that cuts off electricity to part of a home
vocabulary.example: Turn off the breaker for the bathroom.

vocabulary.vi: người quản lý/trông coi tòa nhà
vocabulary.definition: a person employed to look after a building
vocabulary.example: The caretaker came up with a master key.

vocabulary.definition: a key that opens all the doors in a building
vocabulary.example: Only the caretaker has a master key.

vocabulary.vi: bảo hiểm cho người thuê nhà
vocabulary.definition: insurance that covers a renter's belongings and liability
vocabulary.example: Your tenant insurance will want photos of the damage.

review.notes: Blind-solved all 4 Qs; key matched. 3/4 missed_info (meets 70% drill target). Evidence, traps and Vietnamese checked; tenant-insurance/emergency-line advice is sensible. No changes needed.
